a.text: Oh, you came to the library too. What a coincidence.
Hello, Yu. Are you here to look up some case files?
Just grabbing some books to put under my pillow. I haven't been sleeping well lately—maybe some reading will help.
How I envy the life of a student. Their brains are filled with books, not worries.
Surely you're joking.
I'm not joking at all. Investigating these sordid cases for the Judicial Review Office every day is bound to make one feel sick.
They say the Baizao Academy library is the cleanest and purest place in the world, where only wise men and sages dwell. So I'll sit here for a while and purify my soul.
Did you use to study here at the Academy too, Gu Quan?
That was many years ago...
I still haven't achieved anything yet, academically, since I graduated from here. I feel unworthy of the academy's prestige.
But I was fortunate to meet a great teacher here, and that experience will benefit me for the rest of my life.
Who is this teacher you speak of?
...No longer with us.
Then why did you come here today? To borrow books?
I'm here to look up some case files...
The Ministry of Rites is preparing for a grand celebration, and we need to refer to some old rituals.
Hah...
I'm a deputy minister for the Judicial Review Office. Do you take me for blind, or merely illiterate?
That thing you have in your hand is clearly the case file from fifteen years ago, when the Grand Preceptor committed treason!
You know that file is top secret, right? You really have some gall!
I... have nothing to hide.
I am indeed looking for materials related to that old case. I think there may be more to it than we realize. If you think I'm doing anything illegal, then by all means, have me arrested.
What are you blabbering about? Did I say I was going to arrest you? I was only saying...
that it's quite a coincidence, because I'm also very interested in that case.

steps.name: Diligent Student
steps.text: I learned a lot from our debate today. However, I still maintain my own views about the new reforms...

steps.name: Diligent Student
steps.text: I'll have to do more research on this.

steps.name: Baizao Lecturer
steps.text: It's fine. This campus is plenty large enough to accommodate a wealth of different ideas. If my arguments have not convinced you, then you should not force yourself to agree with me just because I'm a teacher.

steps.name: Baizao Lecturer
steps.text: The students of this academy must focus on real world issues, instead of getting lost in theoretical or ideological musings.

steps.name: Diligent Student
steps.text: Duoxie.
A clock hangs on the top of the ancient building, the minute hand ticking as the shadow of sunlight moves slowly. The bell rings, and soon, students start pouring out of their classrooms.
A lone figure moves against the tide. The guards fail to notice the unfamiliar face amidst the crowd.

steps.name: Cautious Student
steps.text: Good day. Do you need some help?

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Hello, how do I get to the archives where the students' files are stored?

steps.name: Cautious Student
steps.text: You mean the registrar? What do you want with those files?

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: I'm a new assistant lecturer. The professor wants me to organize the graduates' files.

steps.name: Cautious Student
steps.text: That's odd...

steps.name: Cautious Student
steps.text: Which professor?

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Professor Jing. She teaches military theory at the college affiliated to the Ministry of War.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: She's teaching classes all day today, so she asked me to do this errand for her.

steps.name: Cautious Student
steps.text: Oh!

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: What's wrong?

steps.name: Cautious Student
steps.text: Go straight down here, pass the main building, turn right, and you'll see the Bingshen building. That's it.

steps.name: Cautious Student
steps.text: You'd better get going... Trust me, you don't want to keep her waiting.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: ...Duoxie.

steps.name: Young Chef
steps.text: Ahem, the first rule of any restaurant is that once you enter the kitchen, the chef's words are law.

steps.name: Young Chef
steps.text: If you want to win the contest and meet Mo Bufu, you must follow my instructions to the letter. Do you understand?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Didn't we agree to split the prize money seventy-thirty? Why are you acting like I owe you a favor?

steps.name: Young Chef
steps.text: Okay Okay. Enough of that. Didn't you say you wanted to learn a few new recipes anyway?

steps.name: Young Chef
steps.text: Have you changed your mind?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: No. I want to do this, but I'm no Rhodes Island five-star chef. This competition sounds too difficult for an amateur like me.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Why don't you go instead?

steps.name: Young Chef
steps.text: I am the head chef of Savors at Yu's. Participating in this kind of competition would be sullying my good name.

spans.text: of Savors at Yu's. Participating in this kind of competition would be sullying my good name.

steps.name: Young Chef
steps.text: I'm giving you an opportunity here. As my apprentice, you can go show your skills, and wipe that arrogant smirk off Mo Bufu's face.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Wouldn't Xingzhu be a better choice? She's a foodie, you know.

steps.name: Xingzhu
steps.text: I'm afraid that, as The Wandering Foodie, I'm too well known. It would be inappropriate for me to participate in a food competition.

steps.name: Young Chef
steps.text: Enough chitchat. First thing's first. To get you ready for this competition, let me tell you a little about Ding Feng Lou.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I've been hearing about this place since I first set foot in Baizao. What's so special about it?

steps.name: Xingzhu
steps.text: Remember I told you about the Four Great Restaurants of Baizao, corresponding to the four main branches of Yanese Cuisine, that is, North, South, East, and West?

steps.name: Xingzhu
steps.text: About four hundred years ago, several chefs arrived in Baizao. They each set up their own restaurants and culinary sects. This marked the founding of the four main branches of Yanese cuisine.

steps.name: Xingzhu
steps.text: It was the first head chef of Ding Feng Lou who promoted the founding in the first place.

steps.name: Xingzhu
steps.text: The legendary chef's name has been lost to history. He was the founder of Northern Cuisine, but was also proficient in the other three styles.

steps.name: Xingzhu
steps.text: The other three chefs were only invited to Baizao after they lost to the Northern Chef in a cooking competition.

steps.name: Xingzhu
steps.text: With such a storied history, Ding Feng Lou outshined the other three restaurants and became known as the 'number one restaurant in Baizao.'

steps.name: Young Chef
steps.text: Who's teaching this class, you or me?

steps.name: Xingzhu
steps.text: Oh. My apologies!

steps.name: Young Chef
steps.text: Hmph, of course, what she said is pretty much accurate. The only thing I'll add is that eventually, the Four Great Restaurants of Baizao started fighting with each other for fame and glory. These squabbles continue to this day, and they're really quite annoying.

steps.name: Young Chef
steps.text: I thought Baizao was a place where all these great chefs could learn from each other. If I had known there was going to be all this infighting, I would not have gone...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Not have gone where?

steps.name: Young Chef
steps.text: Ahem...!

steps.name: Young Chef
steps.text: In any case, what you need to know is that, as the most famous restaurant in Baizao, Ding Feng Lou, and its Chef Selection Competition, has extremely high standards.

steps.name: Young Chef
steps.text: Ding Feng Lou has not taken on any new disciples in many years. The only reason they're hosting this competition now is because they suddenly got short-handed right when they needed to start preparing for the Feast of a Hundred Delicacies.

steps.name: Xingzhu
steps.text: But I've also heard that Chef Mo is advancing in age and still hasn't found an apprentice to take over the business...

steps.name: Young Chef
steps.text: The format of the competition is different each time, but there is one requirement that stays constant: each chef has to showcase their best dish.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Wait a second...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: If the competition is really that difficult, how can I ever hope to win?

steps.name: Young Chef
steps.text: Logic would dictate that an amateur chef with absolutely no culinary experience would have little hope of winning.

steps.name: Young Chef
steps.text: However, you have me in your corner. I can teach you a recipe that is easy to cook and is perfect for the occasion—

steps.name: Young Chef
steps.text: Longevity noodles.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Longevity noodles? Why would they serve longevity noodles at the Feast of a Hundred Delicacies?

steps.name: Xingzhu
steps.text: The reigning True Lung's birthday just happens to coincide with the Mid-Autumn Festival, so every year, they serve longevity noodles at the Feast.

steps.name: Xingzhu
steps.text: But it's such a simple dish. Is it really appropriate for a major competition like this?

steps.name: Young Chef
steps.text: Who told you that simple dishes can't show great skills?

steps.name: Young Chef
steps.text: Just watch and learn.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: What's that smell...? That smells wonderful! What is it?

steps.name: Young Chef
steps.text: Hm-hmm—

steps.name: Young Chef
steps.text: What do you think?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: It's like magic! You really only used the ingredients you showed us before? Nothing else?

steps.name: Xingzhu
steps.text: Fresh shellbeast meat, mushrooms, scallions, bok choy...

steps.name: Xingzhu
steps.text: It's a simple recipe with basic ingredients, but the result is truly amazing.

steps.name: Young Chef
steps.text: Sometimes, the true skill of a chef hides in unseen places. There's more to this bowl of noodles than meets the eye.

steps.name: Young Chef
steps.text: Another chef can use these exact same ingredients, but if the ratios, the heat, or the cooking time vary just a little bit, it'll taste completely different. Do you know how long I spent perfecting this recipe?

steps.name: Young Chef
steps.text: Don't just stand there. Dig in!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Wow.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I take back any criticism I had of your food!

steps.name: Young Chef
steps.text: You just inhaled it! Did you even taste the flavor?!

steps.name: Xingzhu
steps.text: If Blaze can actually replicate that taste, maybe she really can meet Chef Mo.

steps.name: Xingzhu
steps.text: But are you really up to the task, Blaze?

steps.name: Young Chef
steps.text: Figuring out the secret to this recipe would be difficult indeed. But simply following its steps should not be too much trouble.

steps.name: Young Chef
steps.text: Have you ever cooked anything before?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Of course!

steps.name: Young Chef
steps.text: Ah. That's good then.

steps.name: Young Chef
steps.text: Now I'll give you the recipe and explain every step for you. Follow them exactly, and you'll be fine.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Great! I'll study hard! I won't disappoint you!

steps.name: Angry Voice
steps.text: Didn't you say you knew how to cook?!

steps.name: Aggrieved Voice
steps.text: The instant noodles are already pre-made! How should I know how to knead flour into dough?

steps.name: Angry Voice
steps.text: You really are a hopeless case!

steps.name: Aggrieved Voice
steps.text: You haven't really even taught me anything yet...

steps.name: Angry Voice
steps.text: How can I teach you anything? You managed to break three bowls just while kneading the dough! I can't risk you breaking anything else here!

steps.name: Jiang
steps.text: Aiyo... aiyo...

steps.name: Jiang
steps.text: Be careful... These bowls are expensive... We can't afford to buy new ones—

steps.name: Jiang
steps.text: *sigh*

a.text: SearchtGu Quan
FiltertReturned from Victoria
No results

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Why are there no records at all?

a.text: SearchtGu Quan
FiltertEnrolled in 1076
No results
SearchtGu Quan
FiltertMinistry of Rites
No results

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: What is going on?

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Gu Quan, an ethnic Yanese born and raised in Victoria, returned to Yan in 1074. In 1076, he was admitted to Baizao Academy. After completing his studies, he joined the Ministry of Rites...

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: These are the only records left for the deceased in that case.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: They should have files for all mandarins who graduated from the Imperial Academy and went to work in the Six Ministries of the court… but why can't I find him in the system?

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Gu Quan, what did you...?

steps.name: Voice Outside the Door
steps.text: Professor, I was just trying to confirm that with you. I didn't mean to ask you to come here in person...

steps.name: Stern Voice
steps.text: She said she's a new assistant professor? Why haven't I ever heard of her before?

steps.name: Voice Outside the Door
steps.text: The person who came here seemed to know you very well, so I didn't...

steps.name: Stern Voice
steps.text: How many times have I told you? The Academy's personnel files are confidential! Keep that in mind!

steps.name: Stern Voice
steps.text: Forget it. I'll go handle this myself.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Oh no!

steps.name: Stern Professor
steps.text: Hmm?
The room is empty and the documents on the desk are still where they were, without any signs of having been moved.

steps.name: Stern Professor
steps.text: Qingyan, you're a bit too old to be playing hide-and-seek, aren't you?

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: J-Jing...

steps.name: Stern Professor
steps.text: Has the Judicial Review Office come to our school to apprehend some culprit?

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: The Office is investigating a case, so I've come here to collect a few old case files. Please, Jing... Professor Jing... Please cooperate.

steps.name: Professor Jing
steps.text: Alright then. If you're here on official business, show me your official documentation.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: I rushed so quickly to get here that I left it back at my office.

steps.name: Professor Jing
steps.text: Really? Well then I'll just place a call in to the head of the Office.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Wait... wait a moment!

steps.name: Voice Outside the Door
steps.text: Professor, are you okay?

steps.name: Voice Outside the Door
steps.text: Should I call security?

steps.name: Professor Jing
steps.text: *sigh*

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: (gives a pleading look)

steps.name: Professor Jing
steps.text: No. I forgot that I asked some other professor here to collect some materials for me.

steps.name: Professor Jing
steps.text: I'm sorry for wasting your time.

steps.name: Voice Outside the Door
steps.text: It's not a problem! Goodbye, professor!

steps.name: Professor Jing
steps.text: Alright. Now it's just the two of us.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Xie... Xiexie.

steps.name: Professor Jing
steps.text: *sigh* Qingyan...

steps.name: Professor Jing
steps.text: I have always thought that you were a well-mannered and trustworthy girl. Every time I mentioned you to Le, I told him to follow your example.

steps.name: Professor Jing
steps.text: And look at you now—What are you doing here? A deputy minister from the Judicial Review Office, sneaking around like this?

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: I'm conducting an investigation...

steps.name: Professor Jing
steps.text: What kind of case requires this secrecy? What kind of case can't go through the normal process?

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: A cold case... the deceased was once a student at the Baizao Academy, but I just searched the personnel files and found no record of him.

steps.name: Professor Jing
steps.text: The Academy has a record of every student. This person you speak of, how do you know they once studied here?

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: I saw it in the files at the Judicial Review Office.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: The Judicial Review Office collects its files directly from the Ministry of Rites. However, the Ministry's files do not match up with the Academy's. Someone made a mistake somewhere.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Is there a chance that someone altered the Academy's files?

steps.name: Professor Jing
steps.text: How could that possibly have happened?

steps.name: Professor Jing
steps.text: The Academy is one of the Yanese government's most important talent pipelines. Once a student's information is entered into the system, it is archived under strict supervision.

steps.name: Professor Jing
steps.text: No one has the authority to modify this data, unless...

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Unless what...?

steps.name: Professor Jing
steps.text: No. That's impossible.

steps.name: Professor Jing
steps.text: Enough of this nonsense. You'd better leave now.

steps.name: Professor Jing
steps.text: It's almost mealtime. Pretty soon, lots of students will be crowding these halls. If anyone else sees you here...

steps.name: Professor Jing
steps.text: Also, please don't go doing something like this again.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Mealtime...

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: We need to go back to Baizao to investigate. Why are you looking at all these travel guides?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: These places... I've seen them in my dad's letters.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Humble Garden, Virtue Bookstore... oh and when he was studying here, there was a Shangshu Diner near the main entrance. He said they have the best twice-cooked pork in town!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Now that I'm visiting Baizao, I want to visit all the places he mentioned to me.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Say, is there a restaurant near campus called the Shangshu Diner?

steps.name: Professor Jing
steps.text: Huh? You want Shangshu food?

steps.name: Professor Jing
steps.text: The place you're talking about closed more than thirty years ago. How would you possibly know about it?

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: More than thirty years ago? Are you sure?

steps.name: Professor Jing
steps.text: Yes. It closed in 1065 when I was in school. How could I forget?

steps.name: Professor Jing
steps.text: Lots of students used to go eat there, because it was near campus and served tasty, affordable food.

steps.name: Professor Jing
steps.text: But then, in 1065, there was a terrible Catastrophe in Shangshu, and the restaurant owner had to return home to deal with the aftermath. The students even made donations to help with the rescue effort.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: A man who was born and raised in Victoria and did not come to Yan until 1074... how could he know about the place?

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Unless...

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Unless he had visited Yan before, or maybe he wasn't born and raised in Victoria after all? Maybe he was a native Yanese?

steps.name: Professor Jing
steps.text: What are you mumbling about?

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: If Gu Quan's Ministry of Rites records were modified, but he was indeed a student at the Academy, well then, there would definitely be something worth digging up in the Academy's files.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: What year was Blaze born? If we work back from there...

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Does this system have the records of students enrolled between 1052 and 1062?

steps.name: Professor Jing
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Help me just this once. It's extremely important...

steps.name: Professor Jing
steps.text: Thousands of students graduate each year. You want to look through ten years of records at once? Do you know how long that will take?

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: The person in question worked for the Ministry of Rites. He probably studied at an affiliated college. That may help narrow the search a bit.

steps.name: Professor Jing
steps.text: If the person you are looking for was not a high-ranking mandarin, you may want to start looking at files after 1055.

steps.name: Professor Jing
steps.text: That year, the Academy was restructured. It became a true public education institution, instead of just serving as a talent pipeline for the government. The enrollment figures shot up.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: I see... Duoxie!

steps.name: Professor Jing
steps.text: Go. You only have two hours.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Found you...

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: ...Gu Sheng.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Male, born in Langyi in 1037, accepted into Baizao Academy in 1055. He was assigned to the Education Department administered by the Ministry of Rites... and was among the first batch of students to enroll after the school was restructured.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Top marks in all subjects... Wait. He didn't graduate?

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: This file was last updated in... 1062?

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: This is a missing persons file?
'Gu Sheng, along with his wife and daughter, disappeared in 1062. Accordingly, this file has been sealed.'

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: So he was already a family man when he was in Baizao... and all three of them disappeared...

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: 1062... Is there something special about 1062?

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Blaze... I need to confirm something...

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: You were born in 1062, in Victoria, right?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Yes. From as far back as I can remember, I lived in Victoria.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: I asked you where you were born!

spans.text: I asked you where you were

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: How am I supposed to remember that?

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Gu Quan... Gu Sheng...

steps.name: Professor Jing
steps.text: Qingyan, your time is almost up. You should get going.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: What did he say?

steps.name: Xingzhu
steps.text: No good. The dough still won't do. Let's try again.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: But that's already my twentieth batch!

steps.name: Xingzhu
steps.text: Don't worry, you have been practicing all day, and you're starting to iron out the issues with your technique. Success is not far away.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I'm really sorry. You don't need to stay here with me through all this.

steps.name: Xingzhu
steps.text: It's not a problem!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: You've been helping me so much, I guess you must also be interested in the outcome of all of this, huh?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Alright. Just wait here a minute. This time I'm sure I'll do it, and I'll whip you up a big, nice bowl of noodles for dinner.

steps.name: Xingzhu
steps.text: Did you... have something else you wanted to say to me just now?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Xingzhu
steps.text: N-Never mind...

steps.name: Xingzhu
steps.text: To be fair, the recipe the Young Chef gave you was indeed simple enough. He probably didn't expect that your biggest difficulty would be kneading the dough.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Look at you defending him!

steps.name: Xingzhu
steps.text: I'm sorry...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I'm doing all I can do. It's hard. When I work, my body temperature rises, and the dough starts to dry out in just a few seconds.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I add more water to the flour, and then more flour to the water, and then more flour and water... The dough that was originally the size of my fist is now almost as big as my head!

steps.name: Xingzhu
steps.text: The situation with your rising body temperature is certainly unique...

steps.name: Xingzhu
steps.text: Anyway, you need to think positively: so long as you learn to knead the dough, making the longevity noodles will be no problem at all!

steps.name: Xingzhu
steps.text: Speaking of which, for someone who has never cooked before, you certainly have some impressive knife skills.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Well, back at Rhodes Island, elite operators like me perform surgery on ourselves in emergency situations.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I guess there's not much difference between using a scalpel and a kitchen knife, assuming you're not using it like the Young Chef does when he chops vegetables.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I can even use the skills I learned from stitching my own wounds to mend my own clothes.

steps.name: Xingzhu
steps.text: I wouldn't have thought your job would be this dangerous.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Hmph, not a big deal if you have the time to practice.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: The more I think about it, the angrier I get. Can't he just have more patience with me?

steps.name: Xingzhu
steps.text: Hey! Look! I think you're getting the hang of it. The amount of force is just right. Keep it up!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I... haven't even... had any dinner yet!

steps.name: Xingzhu
steps.text: Hold onto that anger! Fold the dough over and continue kneading. Right. You can get even angrier if you want!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: No. I can't get any angrier... boy the noodles he makes sure are delicious!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I'm spent—

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Ugh... Why is cooking even more exhausting than combat training?

steps.name: Xingzhu
steps.text: I understand this is really hard for you...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I don't want to deal with that pipsqueak anymore! Can I be your apprentice instead? You're a gourmand. You must know how to cook, right?

steps.name: Xingzhu
steps.text: Spare me the compliments... I am nothing close to him when it comes to cooking.

steps.name: Xingzhu
steps.text: And you know, it's funny that I've never actually eaten longevity noodles before.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: They are just noodles, right? You've tried so many different restaurants. How could you have never eaten longevity noodles before?

steps.name: Xingzhu
steps.text: I've been to many restaurants that serve longevity noodles, but it only makes sense to eat them on your birthday!

steps.name: Xingzhu
steps.text: I celebrate every birthday at home. They don't allow me to go out on my birthday.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Okay, but even if you celebrate your birthdays at home, your mom or dad never made you a bowl of longevity noodles?

steps.name: Xingzhu
steps.text: Actually, I've never met my parents...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Oh, I'm sorry...

steps.name: Xingzhu
steps.text: Although I have never seen my parents, I still have other family members. Every year, on my birthday, my family holds a big banquet for me.

steps.name: Xingzhu
steps.text: At banquets like that, I don't think they care much about longevity noodles.

steps.name: Xingzhu
steps.text: However, I've always been a little afraid of birthdays...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Isn't it nice that other people remember your birthday?

steps.name: Xingzhu
steps.text: I can't really explain it. I always feel that every time I have a birthday party, I will be surrounded by a lot of people who want me to laugh, and also to cry.

steps.name: Xingzhu
steps.text: But it doesn't seem to matter whether I'm there or not...

steps.name: Xingzhu
steps.text: Enough talk about me. You're from Victoria. Do they eat longevity noodles there?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I grew up in Victoria, but my parents are both Yanese, at least, by blood.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: When I was little, every year, on my birthday, my mom would make me a bowl of longevity noodles. The taste was nothing special. It was just regular old home cooking.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: After I left home and could no longer eat my mom's home cooking, I even forgot what it was like to celebrate a birthday.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: That is, until that night...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: The seasoning packet, the vegetable packet... and I'll add two sausages, hehe... why are the lights off in the cafeteria?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Hey! What are you guys doing here? You scared me!

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: Shhh, keep your voice down.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: It's late. What are you doing in the cafeteria at this hour?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Ace... why do you look all serious? There's not another urgent mission, is there?

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: What are you holding there? Instant noodles?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I stayed too long at the training ground this afternoon and didn't have enough for dinner!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: What? Now that I'm an elite operator, I can't eat instant noodles anymore?

steps.name: Touch
steps.text: The captain isn't scolding you for eating junk food. He's saying...

steps.name: Touch
steps.text: Today is your birthday, and you're eating instant noodles?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: My birthday...?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: But didn't Dr. Kal'tsit say—

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: That's why I told you to lower your voice.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: So long as we don't make too much noise, even if she hears us, she'll pretend not to hear, yes?

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: I even suspect that she deliberately arranged for our fieldwork breaks to overlap, just so we could throw you a birthday party.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Think of it as her way of giving you a birthday blessing... even if it's hard to imagine.

steps.name: Touch
steps.text: Blaze, you are one of us, a part of Rhodes Island. You are not alone.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I... you... thank you all so much!

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: Alright. It's already midnight. Happy birthday, Blaze!

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: Happy birthday, Big Cat!

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Happy Birthday.

steps.name: Touch
steps.text: Happy birthday! Also, Amiya isn't on the ship right now, but she asked me to pass on the birthday wishes. She hopes you stay happy and healthy!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Aww... Bunny...

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: So, are you planning to come blow out the candles and cut the cake, or are you going back to your instant noodles?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: That was the first time so many people celebrated my birthday with me. That bowl of instant noodles became my longevity noodles.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Everyone knew how much I wanted to have a birthday party, but that day, not a single person actually came out and said, 'I knew you wanted this'.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: They acted like... it was just another one of my many, many birthdays.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I liked the 'nothing special' feeling of it.

steps.name: Xingzhu
steps.text: Now you're making me jealous...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Oh, right! You said you've never had longevity noodles. Well, let me whip up some for you!

steps.name: Xingzhu
steps.text: But... you haven't even learned how to knead the dough yet...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I don't know how to knead noodles, but I do know how to cook ready-made noodles. I'll go ask Jiang for some dried noodles that I can simply boil.

steps.name: Xingzhu
steps.text: Wait... handmade noodles... ready-made noodles...

steps.name: Xingzhu
steps.text: Maybe it really will work, after all!
